description.zh: 莫斯科沙皇国自伊凡四世加冕'全俄罗斯沙皇'始，至彼得大帝改革前夕，是俄罗斯专制制度的成型期。沙皇自称'全俄罗斯的专制君主'，以'第三罗马'自居，继承拜占庭正教传统。贵族杜马以'沙皇圣裁、波雅尔议定'合议，诸衙门（приказы）按职能分理政务，莫斯科牧首（1589年设）与皇权'和谐'共治，督军（воевода）治理地方。（彼得大帝后的参政院、最高会议与各部制属18世纪另一帝国体制。）
description.en: The Muscovite Tsardom, from Ivan IV's coronation as 'Tsar of All Rus'' to the eve of Peter the Great's reforms, was the formative phase of Russian autocracy. The Tsar styled himself 'Autocrat of All the Russias,' claiming the 'Third Rome' and Byzantine Orthodox legacy. The Boyar Duma deliberated under 'the sovereign decreed and the boyars affirmed'; chancelleries (prikazy) handled affairs by function; the Patriarch of Moscow (est. 1589) co-governed in Orthodox symphony; and voevody administered the localities. (The post-Petrine Senate, Synod, and ministries are a distinct 18th-c. imperial order.)
